ReviewedInteractions.Rationale: The 2.7.1 bulk-detour constructors now share one transaction and scanner; the audited target patterns remain unchanged, and release mods create independent transactions only for their own non-overlapping targets.
Six hash-bound call-site adapters consume the Script Extender-owned result at RVA/module offset 0x196870; positive Vanilla or extender results remain authoritative.
The inline site at RVA/module offset 0x704CC remains inside the original trampoline path of the extender detour at RVA/module offset 0x6FE90; SkipOriginalFunction remains authoritative.

The corrected AIV import signature and current-to-destination path-component argument order are consumed through public APIs or delegate calls; no release mod installs a competing entry detour at those extender-owned targets.
The vegetation-growth signature was lengthened without moving its hook site; no release project patches or detours that site.

References to extender-owned native functions are validated calls or enclosing function bounds, not competing function-entry detours; manager ID adjustments and the marked 2.7.1 projectile-bound workaround remain at the managed array/index boundary.
